commit_policy: Local PGP unlock at entry; verified signed incremental checkpoints; no automatic push.
scope: Explicit bounded implementation of native durable authoring, additive canonical schema, coherent catalog/editors, immutable publication and exact launch/recovery; preserve the existing UI cut.
operational_limits: Only task-owned isolated fixtures; no real profile migration/deployment, paid inference, auth rewrite or unrelated engine redesign.

shared_policy.necessary_change_owner: Codex, in the current repository, with minimal reviewed signed changes

revision_note: Packaging/policy revision only; original PC3 product scope and acceptance obligations retained; no new source review.
